reasoning: Started from the thread's quarterly driver set and the run facts (FY26 revenue 7,118, non-GAAP EBIT 1,457, net debt 1,235, Series B preferred converted, NVIDIA $2B placement). Skeptic research: Earnings Whispers (credibility test, gross margin stuck ~40% vs >42% goal, Q4 capex $556M, whisper 2.05 at top of guide), TIKR (cash burn; 'lower-margin, cash-burning name'; $1.56B net debt; CTO and director sales in September), CFO 10b5-1 sale (April), S&P BB- with leverage once inflated by the Bain preferred (now converted), SemiAnalysis CPO timing and the June -9.85% day, Barron's/JPM on CPO expectations too high, Innolight's capacity and capital raise, Zacks (inventory +79.5%, management expects capex up again, AAOI/LITE adding capacity), B. Riley's earlier 1.6T allocation call (NVIDIA multi-sourcing), Marvell-Lumentum bundling risk, FutureSearch 15% odds of a capex pullback by end-2027 and UBS 2028 hyperscaler capex +6%. Weighed honestly, near-term demand is strong (booked out, 4/4 revenue beats), so Q1 FY27 is left at the record-adjusted 2,370; the skeptic case bites from CY27: capture haircut 2-8% and D&C margin capped at 26.5% vs the set's 27.5%, giving FY28 EPS 11.85 (~-10% vs set 13.19, ~-15% vs company-basis Street) and revenue 13.0B (~-9% vs Street 14.41B). Valuation: 0.7 on build NTM EPS at 19.2x (peer median 22.1x of 5 genuine peers, k=0.8 shrink, basis restated), 0.3 on mid-cycle EPS 9.45 at 22x because FY28-29 are probably near-peak years, plus a skeptic-weighted +440M share-shift adjustment. Base ~$236 (+12% vs $210.41), downside P10 ~$106 (capture -30%, margin -4pt, multiple -6), upside P90 ~$395; left tail fatter. Research was limited: the 10-K text past the risk factors could not be read via fetch (sec.gov blocked curl), no newer credit rating action found, and no short-seller report on COHR found. Not driver-linked: the mid-cycle EPS stated on the second leg and the share-shift adjustment.

model_inputs.structure_note: Driver-led quarterly set built on the thread's proposal (dc_capture x LightCounting market, dc_margin, ind_rev, ind_margin; corporate and lite_shift constants unchanged). Value carried by two P/E legs: 0.7 on the build's own horizon NTM EPS at 19.2x (peer median 22.1x shrunk k=0.8 from own multiple, restated to company basis) and 0.3 on mid-cycle EPS 9.45 at 22x (playbook normalized-earnings cross-check, because FY28-29 are likely near-peak AI-optics years). Plus a +440 equity adjustment for the post-NTM Marvell-Lumentum shift. No DCF (policy). No SOTP: Industrial is ~17% and its segment peers (IPGP 32.9x, MKSI 12.3x, NOVT 35.1x) bracket the blended multiple.

horizon_multiples.peer_basis: whole-company optics peer median 22.1x (FN, AAOI, CRDO, CIEN, MTSI; peers.md NTM P/E), shrunk with k=0.8 from COHR's own ~20.6x (Zacks basis) and restated on company non-GAAP basis
through-cycle: peer median 22.1x on mid-cycle (normalized) EPS

model_inputs.gap_note: Judgment calls for Kilian: (1) dc_capture haircut x0.93-0.92 from FY28 vs thread set (~-$17/share); (2) dc_margin held at 26.5% vs 27.5% (~-$9); (3) 0.3 weight on a mid-cycle EPS leg (~-$10 vs P/E alone); (4) Marvell-Lumentum adjustment skeptic-weighted (+440 vs ~+1,230 at the appraisal base). Financing below 20%: an equity raise or convertible by the horizon ~10% (FCF ~breakeven FY27 with 2.0B cash+STI, but capex Q4 run-rate 2.2B/yr and inventory 2.58B leave little room for a demand hiccup, TIKR); named, not modelled. S&P BB- (stable since 2025-07) - no newer rating action found. Q1 FY27 print on 2026-11-04 is inside the 1-month window; the set should be updated after it.
